result:
Perfect! **All tests pass.** The fix was simple but crucial:

**The bug:** The condition `while len(head) > 3:` was preventing the correct splitting of digits when exactly 3 digits remained after extracting the last 3-digit group.

**The fix:** Changed it to `while len(head) > 2:` so that any remaining digits beyond the first 2 are split into 2-digit groups from the right, following Indian number formatting.

Now 12345678 paise correctly displays as **₹1,23,456.78** instead of **₹123,456.78**.
